label: Spacetime occupancy and necessary-root grounding bridge with an actual-edge omission control
summary: Reused spatial identity and translation, boost simultaneity, temporal history, three spatiotemporal senses, necessary-underived existence and same-witness vocabulary. Froze Challenge, wrote conditional pointwise and existential Solution, and a populated Bool countermodel with an actual root-to-whole existential-grounding edge that defeats the proposed nonlocation conclusion without the whole-to-occupant bridge. No symmetry-to-identity, cone-to-causation, history-to-eternity, or physical-to-existential-grounding inference is assumed; grounding throughout is only the selected Profile.grounds relation, not DEF-ESSE or a cause of esse. Semantic-challenge repair: added a checked joint model of all four premises with a located occupant distinct from the whole (jointModel) and a checked control that the unrestricted whole-priority bridge contradicts the other three premises (unrestrictedInconsistent), so the located restriction carries the positive work; nonlocation is stated as relative to the one supplied, non-world-indexed frame F; and selectedUnlocated is named as the pointwise entry point for a GOD_4 consumer. Philosophical ontological rivals and precise remaining warrant/consumer are explained in docs/notes/spatial-translation-and-reason.md. Independent semantic challenge on PR #1857 accepted the consequence; its P1/P2 wording and coverage findings are repaired. The linked #1857 result is on main. The subsequent named-root result and anchored regress fork use the same selected-world existential grounding relation.
blocker: The experiments identify material realizers of measured patterns. Applying existential grounding to them requires both an actual concrete pattern bearer and an interpretation of material realization as Profile.grounds. Universal coverage of basic extended bearers remains open. The named result separately needs the actual concrete spatial whole, its contingency, and its existential grounding of each distinct actual occupant.

current_assessment.scope: Existential grounding of spatial occupants and nonoccupation of the same necessary classical God at the selected world.
current_assessment.assessment: The two experiments support realization of particular patterns in an identifiable medium. Applying that evidence to existential grounding requires treating the pattern as a concrete bearer and its realization as an incoming ground. Whether a basic spatial field itself requires such a ground remains open. With universal occupant grounding and acyclicity, insisting that every actual concretum occupies space commits one to an injective regress from each selected recipient. One rule can specify all its edges. The named-root proof gives nonoccupation in the supplied frame for that very encoded classical witness. Its structural separation model allows an incoming ground elsewhere. Essential aseity would impose a further condition.
current_assessment.next_test: Identify the field independently, then determine whether varying its proposed realizer removes the field itself or changes only its measured geometry. Compare the same recipient under both accounts of existential supply.
current_assessment.evidence: Independent targeted recheck at e9174faf3 accepted both spatial result families, the two experiments and the repair distinguishing material realization from existential grounding. The off-world example has the encoded attributes and carries no essential-aseity premise. Delivered in PR #2009.
current_assessment.supersedes: None. The original #1857 finding is retained.
